258616: A strange fourth-year student fascinated by demi-humans. Miligan is an excellent witch with great abilities and a few secrets. Despite her almost fanatical pursuit of her goals, she loves the younger students and enjoys teaching them.
258617: Darius Grenville is the Alchemy Instructor of Kimberly Magic Academy. He is famous for stealing research results from the brighter students and presenting them as his own theories. Darius thinks very highly of himself.
258618: Oliver attends Kimberly Magic Academy to better refine his vast skills. Upon arriving, he meets the likes of Nanao, Chela, Katie, Guy, and Pete, their tight-knit bond eventually leading to the formation of the Sword Roses alliance.
258620: Hailing from Tourikueisen in the distant country of Yamatsukuni, Nanao is a samurai girl who was offered a second chance at life by Theodore McFarlane. She attends Kimberly at his behest and finds a new purpose in life in crossing blades with Oliver Horn.
258621: A friend of Oliver's and a member of the Sword Roses. Guy is cheerful and friendly, with a frank and pleasant personality and great thoughtfulness and concern towards his friends. He's unusually talented with the use of magical flora.
258623: A friend of Oliver's and a member of the Sword Roses. Pete is a mage born into a nonmagical family that enters Kimberly after scoring well on their difficult entrance exam.
258624: A friend of Oliver's and a member of the Sword Roses. Chela is a proud young lady and the eldest daughter of the noble house of McFarlane, one of the five oldest families in Yelgland, and among the elite in the Magical World.
258625: An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy. Ophelia is a mysterious witch from a family of succubi who lives in the depths of the academy's labyrinth.
258626: A friend of Oliver's and a member of the Sword Roses. Katie has very strong ideals compared to the typical mage, desiring to reform magical society's treatment of demi-humans.
258627: A student at Kimberly Magic Academy and a classmate of the Sword Roses. Ytallian by birth, Rossi taught himself the sword by ignoring the fundamentals out of dislike for the three standard Sword Arts styles. He has sharp instincts and his combat style is based around dirty play.
258628: Esmeralda is the headmistress of Kimberly Magic Academy. Her fame—and infamy—extends far beyond the Union’s borders. Due to mysterious circumstances, she is afflicted with strange, untreatable headaches.
267387: A student at Kimberly Magic Academy. She is in the year below the Sword Roses.
267388: An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy and the current Student Council President. Godfrey is kind and compassionate towards the younger students, protecting them from the more twisted attendants of the school.
285393: The magical engineering instructor at Kimberly Magic Academy. Enrico is prone to designing outrageous lessons designed to maim students. His forte is making golems, and he believes the pursuit of sorcery and technology lies outside the bounds of morality.
304173: A student at Kimberly Magic Academy and a classmate of the Sword Roses. He is the heir to the Andrews noble family. Initially seeing Oliver as a rival after misunderstandings that antagonized the two, he later duels him in a proper rematch and begins to see him as a friend.
304174: An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy. Rivermoore is a necromancer who controls the bones of the dead, and is considered equally dangerous as Ophelia.
304175: An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy. Carlos is an androgynous youth with a beautiful voice. They were assigned male at birth but was rendered Castrato—magically neutered—in order to be rendered immune to Ophelia Salvadori's Perfume.
